title: Engineering meets Bamboo Architecture
subtitle: Designing with Bamboo
speaker: Vishwa and Janith
speakerRole: Engineering students, University of Moratuwa; Trishanthy and Stesha, architecture students, General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University
description: An online lecture exploring how engineering and architecture meet through bamboo design, materials and innovative solutions. The session features Vishwa and Janith from the University of Moratuwa, and Trishanthy and Stesha from General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University.

title: SRINBAR at Ruhunu Expo
description:
A new platform for Sri Lanka’s bamboo and rattan industry!

Lanka Network for Bamboo and Rattan – SRINBAR will be participating in the Ruhunu Expo Industrial Exhibition, showcasing the creativity, skills, and unique craftsmanship of local bamboo and rattan artisans.

Come and explore a wide range of beautiful and innovative products made from bamboo and rattan, while supporting our talented local artisans and promoting Sri Lanka’s traditional craft industry.

Let’s support local industries and give greater value to the creativity of our local craftsmen and women!
